Hello Everyone, 
I am starting a series on trading! This is the first part in the series with more video’s to come on trading. Trading may seem scary to new players, but I wanna help all players feel comfortable trading. 

I will be adding this video & all upcoming video’s on trading in a new playlist called “Trading Tips”. 

I wanna give a big shout out and thank @hesezimcute for helping me show you all how a trade is done. 

If you like what you just watched please consider connecting with me on the platforms below, as well as liking and subscribing.
